selection: first planned card in order with all dependencies evidence-verified complete

cards.title: Capture qualified framework baseline
cards.invariant: Implementation starts only on a clean Wave-3-qualified DeltaFuse 3.0.0 commit, preserving the active qualification work.
steps: Read QF-025 evidence and verify referenced files and full SHA; absence means blocked, not permission to complete Wave 3 here.
Record git SHA/status, version, input-document hash and runtime locations outside committed machine-specific config.
Create an isolated codex/j03-document-flow implementation branch only after the prerequisite is satisfied; do not absorb dirty files.
cards.red: Negative readiness fixture: dirty tree, absent QF-025 evidence or a version other than 3.0.0 prevents implementation entry.
cards.green: Baseline manifest references actual completed qualification evidence and a clean tree. Planning docs are committed separately or explicitly included before capture.
cards.test: Read-only git status/rev-parse, VERSION and evidence hash checks; record commands in package 00 RESULT.

cards.title: Prove external Worker instrumentation feasibility
read_set: locally installed little-coder package.json and README
cards.invariant: Do not build an adapter around imaginary flags or unavailable measurements.
steps: Inventory installed little-coder, pi and Node exact versions/hashes; current observed little-coder 1.19.0 is a lead, not a pin.
Use documented RPC/extension hooks to list observable model requests, usage, tools, compactions, active model and thinking retention.
Map disabled dispatch/browser/fetch, user-extension discovery, plan/action substitution and shell hooks to effective enforcement mechanisms.
Run a non-model scripted event probe where supported; record missing hooks as blockers with a bounded remedy card before package 05.
cards.red: Unsupported token provenance, silent model switching or unobservable shell reads must be marked unsupported, never implemented with estimates.
cards.green: A table maps every required observation/control to versioned local source evidence, transport event, probe and remaining gap; no live inference requested by this card.
cards.test: Inspect package sources and run only documented help/scripted probes; preserve argv/output/version evidence.

cards.title: Freeze public semantics and judge observability
cards.invariant: Every hidden assertion has public semantics, and benchmark witness files fit existing Core envelopes.
steps: Resolve DEC-A through DEC-H from DECISIONS.md, using stated defaults only where within the given intent; record unresolved material choices as real Human Gates.
Define exact endpoint, identity, actor-role, idempotency, late/invalid ordering and supersede-ownership contracts.
Place typed normative witness blocks in existing allowed Change/spec artifact paths; prove the format is public and never requires an unauthorized extra write.
Separate normative behavior from test instrumentation and private judge fixtures.
cards.red: Counterexample: a hidden expectation absent from intake/spec, a witness written outside the envelope, or a distributed-ACID promise is rejected.
cards.green: Every requirement has a public contract anchor and observable check mapping; no unresolved choice affects scored behavior.
cards.test: Contract review against INSTRUCTION sections 3–4, Core envelope examples and SCORING-PLAN registry.

cards.title: Define reproducible host and dependency provisioning
cards.invariant: Provisioning is explicit; qualification uses pinned artifacts with no arbitrary network.
steps: Inventory Java 21, Maven, Python, Node, Docker/Compose and Linux container support; user enabled daemon, remeasure rather than assume.
Specify allowed artifact repositories, offline Maven/npm/wheel caches, image digest resolution, limits and evidence paths.
Separate provisioning network from Worker inference-only egress and private product traffic.
Document resource-budget calibration procedure without inventing version digests or post-hoc tolerances.
cards.red: A tag-only image, JDK 25 pretending to be Java 21, cold missing offline dependency or mutable npm caret range cannot qualify.
cards.green: Host profile fields, provenance sources and exact future preflight checks are specified; missing installations are explicit.
cards.test: java -version; mvn -version; docker version/info/compose version; package inventory, read-only.

cards.title: Create frozen check registry
cards.invariant: Check IDs, weights, prerequisites and critical gates are judge-owned and sum exactly to the published scales.
steps: Create closed registry rows for all stage/system IDs in SCORING-PLAN.
Validate duplicate IDs, missing categories, weight sums and unknown check references.
Version/hash the registry; no live run can override weights.
cards.red: Duplicate an ID, change a group total or inject an unknown outcome ID; registry validation must reject it.
cards.green: Seven correctness totals=600, discipline=250 each; system totals=1800/600/400/200; all hard gates independently identifiable.

cards.title: Define raw event schemas and safe decoding
cards.invariant: Every raw event is typed, closed and linked to a run/call/stage with measured-or-missing provenance.
steps: Implement local-only JSON Schema loading and safe JSON decoding with duplicate-key/nonfinite rejection.
Define Core, model-call, file access, command, compaction, boundary and Human Gate event variants.
Close all nested objects, enforce identity/hash/count types and explicit null measurements.
cards.red: Unknown nested fields, duplicate JSON keys, bool counts, NaN, broken references and unsupported event kinds fail.
cards.green: All event variants validate, null measurement remains distinguishable from zero, remote refs never resolve.

cards.title: Define stage and system report schemas
cards.invariant: Stage/system reports carry all required identity, evidence, measurement and failure fields with closed nested objects.
steps: Define report envelope including schema/hash, snapshots, attestation refs, events, checks, status, totals and hard failures.
Represent per-task attempts and not-reached stages explicitly; distinguish invalid system infrastructure from product failure.
Require provenance references for measured metrics and test result artifacts.
cards.red: A successful report with absent measurements, missing mandatory stage metadata, invalid enum or score out of bounds fails validation.
cards.green: All seven stage variants and valid/failed/not-reached/invalid system fixtures validate with consistent required fields.

cards.title: Define run and campaign schemas
cards.invariant: An invalid run cannot carry a numeric score, and campaigns cannot omit required members.
steps: Model raw score, applied ceilings, final score, release verdict and failure taxonomy.
Require fixed campaign membership/profile/contract identities, all run refs and aggregate diagnostics.
Allow distinct missing/not-run records without falsely treating them as valid zero-point runs.
cards.red: Null verdict paired with 10000, duplicate runs, fewer than three required runs or missing member references fails.
cards.green: Represent maximum, valid zero-performance=1, failed capped, invalid and incomplete campaign fixtures.

cards.title: Define attestation and variant schemas
cards.invariant: Profiles and variants are independently reproducible identities, not free-form labels.
steps: Model framework SHA/wheel/lock, executor inspect facts, agent dependency/config/extensions hashes and model/provider/tokenizer evidence.
Define variant seed, generator source revision, operation stream hash, ambiguity and workload IDs.
Reject secret values in persisted configuration; store redacted configuration hashes with evidence provenance.
cards.red: Tag-only image, missing provider identity, unmeasured context cap or variant lacking operation hash is rejected for qualification.
cards.green: Measured fixture validates; declared-only facts remain non-release and cannot satisfy release attestation.

cards.title: Implement pure run scoring and failure precedence
cards.invariant: Scores are derived from evaluated checks and exact measurements, never accepted from supplied totals.
steps: Use exact rational arithmetic and half-even rounding; reject invalid primitives.
Implement stage/group summation, 1..10000 clamp, all ceilings and invalidity precedence.
Require all absolute gates independently for release-pass; return deterministic first failure ordering.
cards.red: Exercise 0/1/4999/5000/6999/7000/9999/10000, combined ceilings, forged totals, absent metrics and null provenance.
cards.green: Boundary table in SCORING-PLAN passes; order of input mappings cannot change the result.

cards.title: Implement campaign and comparison arithmetic
cards.invariant: Campaign aggregation preserves all valid failures and invalidates missing/invalid required members.
steps: Validate schedule, uniqueness, profile/host/variant compatibility and independent session identities.
Compute weighted median/min/mean, pass rate, population variance, first failures and per-stage deltas.
Require re-evaluated runs; comparison reports incompatibility rather than ranking unlike campaigns.
cards.red: Drop the lowest run, substitute duplicate sessions, mix profiles, forge totals, or omit an invalid member; reject each.
cards.green: Exact three/four-run fixtures, ties, rounding boundaries and all-failed valid campaigns match hand calculations.

cards.title: Implement evidence store and sealed event integrity
cards.invariant: A Worker cannot rewrite host evidence; rehashed reports remain subject to semantic recomputation.
steps: Canonicalize JSON and define self-hash exclusion; create content-addressed evidence and host sequence chain.
Implement create-only atomic finalization, fsync/recovery, sealed manifest trust root and safe relative refs.
Test missing objects, symlinks/junctions, truncation, replay, path collision and cross-run substitution.
cards.red: Rewrite an old event and all local hashes, remove a segment, or replace a report total+hash; external seal/semantic checks reject.
cards.green: Read-back hashes verify, repeated read/recompute is identical, interrupted writes retain previously finalized reports.

cards.title: Pin Java reactor and offline dependency inventory
cards.invariant: Java 21 and dependency identity are reproducible before any product logic.
steps: Create reactor for shared-contracts and three services with enforced Java 21/compiler/test plugin versions.
Resolve approved exact artifacts/plugins and record full offline inventory with hashes; include test dependencies.
Prove offline build of empty modules uses the inventoried cache without external repositories.
cards.red: Missing cached plugin/transitive artifact or modified jar blocks preflight; JDK mismatch fails explicitly.
cards.green: mvn --offline verify succeeds on the empty reactor under Java 21; dependency lock hashes are measured.

cards.title: Publish baseline event/API contracts
cards.invariant: Baseline DTOs and event versions encode only the working single-step flow, with target changes reserved for intake.
steps: Define immutable envelope, IDs, aggregate sequence, event schema version and correlation causation fields.
Implement strict serialization/validation and baseline API error/idempotency contracts.
Publish capability mapping and public compatibility fixtures; do not leak target implementation.
cards.red: Malformed envelope, unknown schema, missing identity or serialization nondeterminism fails contract tests.
cards.green: Round-trip baseline messages and public API fixtures pass; no target multi-stage transition is implemented.

cards.title: Create isolated service schemas and migrations
cards.invariant: Service-owned databases enforce identity/deduplication and forbid cross-service writes.
steps: Create version, route/decision, inbox/outbox and audit baseline schemas with unique constraints.
Provision separate principals, Flyway histories and restricted judge read-only access.
Test fresh install and upgrade from historical baseline; preserve old migration fixtures.
cards.red: Duplicate identity constraints, forbidden cross-database write and changed applied migration each fail for the expected reason.
cards.green: Fresh/upgrade migrations succeed on pinned PostgreSQL; roles enforce separation and baseline constraints.
cards.test: mvn --offline -f <seed>/pom.xml verify -Pdb-integration (profile created by this card)

cards.title: Implement document baseline commands
cards.invariant: Create draft, create immutable version and submit single-step work with state/outbox written atomically.
steps: Implement document API, immutable version persistence and request idempotency.
Publish submission only through a transactionally written outbox row; duplicate commands return prior observable outcome.
Test version mutation denial, same-key payload conflicts and rollback with no partial state/outbox.
cards.red: Forced failure before commit leaves neither submitted state nor outbox; duplicate command never creates a second version.
cards.green: Baseline document unit/database tests pass for create/version/submit, rollback and duplicates.

cards.title: Implement single-step workflow baseline
cards.invariant: One approver can approve/reject a baseline route with transactional inbox/state/outbox.
steps: Implement single-step route creation and decisions against exact version/route identity.
Enforce inbox dedup and per-document concurrency at database boundary.
Keep target expert/registrar/supersede semantics absent; write baseline unit/database tests.
cards.red: Duplicate message or transaction failure cannot repeat/partially apply a decision; wrong version/route rejected.
cards.green: Single-step approve/reject and isolation tests pass; target multi-stage tests still cannot pass.

cards.title: Implement reliable Kafka inbox/outbox delivery
cards.invariant: Database commit, publisher retries and consumer acknowledgement preserve at-least-once safety.
steps: Implement bounded outbox polling/publishing and inbox transaction boundaries with real Kafka acknowledgements.
Define public invalid-event/DLQ reasons and atomic no-domain-change handling.
Expose controlled crash barriers in the test profile around commit/ack and publish/sent; no judge scenario code in services.
cards.red: Crash at measured barriers creates a duplicate delivery but exactly one baseline domain effect; malformed payload never partially updates state.
cards.green: Kafka/Postgres integration cases prove redelivery, bounded polling and recovery, including publisher restart.

cards.title: Implement audit projection and canonical query
cards.invariant: Replay leaves one append-only audit effect and canonical JSON reflects observed state deterministically.
steps: Implement audit consumer/dedup store and stable per-aggregate ordering.
Implement canonical public query aggregation with synchronization watermark and no state writes.
Include duplicate/reordered baseline events and unavailable downstream query behavior.
cards.red: Replay produces duplicate rows, arrival-order-dependent output or a query that mutates state; tests must expose each.
cards.green: Canonical output stabilizes to expected baseline state, replay is idempotent and audit is not a state authority.

cards.title: Wire pinned Compose stack and fault controls
cards.invariant: One documented command starts the complete baseline on an isolated, bounded, offline-ready stack.
steps: Pin measured image digests, health checks, JVM/container resource limits and separate database principals.
Use private networking and no runtime socket/host checkout mounts; label run-owned resources.
Provide start/readiness/fault/preserve/cleanup procedures with exact ownership checks; avoid sleep-based success.
cards.red: Cold missing dependency, wrong digest, unhealthy service and escaped mount fail with infrastructure classification.
cards.green: Compose config validates and all three services plus Kafka/Postgres become healthy from clean volumes; no manual service editing.
cards.test: docker compose -f <seed>/compose.yaml config; provisioned offline build/up and deadline health probes

cards.title: Prove public baseline end to end
cards.invariant: Actual baseline create/version/submit/approve-or-reject/audit flow is green and observable.
steps: Create public HTTP/Kafka smoke clients with deterministic fixture inputs and deadline polling.
Run unit/integration/system profiles and capture command/build/container identities.
Cover at least approve, reject, immutable version and replay duplicate guard with actual services.
cards.red: A deliberately broken service wiring or duplicate audit implementation fails a named public assertion, not a generic timeout alone.
cards.green: All baseline public tests pass against the real pinned stack and retain logs on failure.

cards.title: Add realistic noise and safe public pack installation
cards.invariant: Worker receives a functional public product with realistic irrelevant files but no judge material.
steps: Add several dozen realistic non-target Java files/DTOs, deprecated adapter, old migration and historical Change without altering baseline behavior.
Publish complete target intake and stage-witness syntax in allowed paths; inventory seed/public assets explicitly.
Install from frozen wheel and public inventory, checking links/reparse points, seed hashes and layout; reject judge artifacts.
cards.red: Place renamed oracle or escaping link in public inventory; init refuses. Opening installed wheel cannot expose judge package.
cards.green: Public baseline remains green, target paths fit bounded packets, and installation/layout/leak tests pass.
cards.test: python -m pytest tests/bench/document_flow/test_install.py -q; public baseline regression; platform layout validators

cards.title: Generate replayable scenario variants
cards.invariant: Saved generator identity and seed reproduce exact operations without hardcoded public IDs.
steps: Generate IDs, actors, document multiplicity, legal delivery orders, duplicates and crash schedules.
Record full operation stream and hash; constrain valid scenarios causally and label deliberate invalid schedules.
Define frozen corpus of calibration and held-out seeds with no reference tuning on held-out results.
cards.red: Same seed differs across supported runtimes, invalid actor reuse appears in a valid scenario, or static public IDs dominate outputs.
cards.green: Cross-platform golden variant hashes match; different seeds alter identities/schedules without altering required semantics.

cards.title: Build independent pure domain interpreter
cards.invariant: Expected state is derived independently of Java product transition code.
steps: Implement bounded pure transitions for version/route/slot decisions, supersede, duplicates, invalid and late events.
Canonicalize audit/state results and expose expected-state-at-barrier API.
Use hand-worked timelines and invariants, not Java reference outputs, as unit-test oracles.
cards.red: Early registrar, same actor in two roles, late superseded decision, wrong version and duplicate effect break explicit hand-derived fixtures.
cards.green: Normal/reject/interleaved/late/conflict cases match independently calculated final state and audit.

cards.title: Create private reference version-supersede implementation
cards.invariant: Reference supersede atomically closes old workflow and opens successor while keeping public seed unchanged.
steps: Apply reference-only patch to a fresh seed copy; implement transaction ownership and version identity.
Preserve late-decision audit with no old-route mutation.
Keep reference assets outside public inventory and independently compare API outcomes to interpreter.
cards.red: Baseline fails supersede checks; reference transaction crash or late decision mutation fails exact scenario checks.
cards.green: Reference version/supersede scenarios pass with actual PostgreSQL, original seed hashes unchanged.

cards.title: Complete private reference parallel approval implementation
cards.invariant: Private reference satisfies two expert roles then registrar, identities, rejection and event idempotency.
steps: Implement expert/registrar state transitions and distinct actor enforcement in private reference patches.
Integrate schema/API/audit compatibility for target Change; preserve transactional delivery.
Prove reference transitions against interpreter for both hand-written and generated sequences.
cards.red: One expert unlocks registrar, actor closes two roles or expert rejection allows later progress; named tests fail.
cards.green: All target domain timelines pass on real reference stack without changing the public baseline tree.

cards.title: Build judge clients and stack execution harness
cards.invariant: Hidden tests access only public APIs/Kafka and allow-listed read-only SQL from a judge-owned harness.
steps: Launch unique run-labelled stacks from snapshot-bound build artifacts; poll readiness and preserve diagnostic output.
Implement HTTP/Kafka clients, SQL assertion allow-list and measured crash-barrier controls.
Classify host/tool failure versus Worker build/behavior failure and use documented nonzero exit codes.
cards.red: Bad image/dropped judge connection is infrastructure-invalid; bad Worker Java compilation is product-build-failure; arbitrary SQL write is denied.
cards.green: Positive reference and negative seed are executed from identified snapshots with complete evidence and no host leaks.
cards.test: python -m pytest tests/bench/document_flow/test_system_runner.py -q; live reference/seed harness probe

cards.title: Freeze hidden functional scenario contract
cards.invariant: All F01-F09 and C02/C03 subcases, weights and independent expectations are frozen before live results.
steps: Implement F01–F09 plus C02/C03 scenarios from registry, with exact expected error/late/audit assertions.
Cover duplicate identities, separate documents, early registrar, both reject roles, supersede before/after partial review.
Prove points derive from all named subcase facts and keep the suite private.
cards.red: Missing hidden modules fail the complete fixed registry and held-out schedule checks.
cards.green: All named scenarios and subcases are frozen with interpreter-derived expectations and fixed weights.

cards.title: Repair live Kafka and DLQ judge boundary
cards.invariant: C02 uses the pinned live Kafka boundary and hash-bound DLQ evidence without host leakage.
steps: Replace the nonexistent broker CLI path with a run-owned service-container Kafka client.
Publish a valid unknown-schema envelope and consume its exact hash-bound DLQ record.
Prove no workflow transition and preserve seed baseline.
cards.red: The frozen Kafka client exits 127 because its pinned CLI path does not exist and has no publish operation.
cards.green: Live C02.dlq and C02.no-transition facts are true on an identified unchanged seed stack.
cards.test: python -m pytest tests/bench/document_flow/test_system_runner.py tests/bench/document_flow/test_hidden_functional_contract.py -q; live C02 seed probe

cards.title: Repair reference audit propagation and rerun frozen scenarios
cards.invariant: Applied and ignored decisions propagate to audit and the cumulative reference passes every frozen fact live.
steps: Add reference-only applied and ignored decision event contracts/outbox propagation/audit projection.
Demonstrate missing audit events as Red and live delivery as Green.
Rerun seed, hardcoded control and cumulative reference for every F01-F09/C02/C03 fact.
cards.red: The cumulative reference fails F01.audit-order and both F06 ignored-decision audit facts.
cards.green: The cumulative reference passes all F01-F09/C02/C03 facts with retained live evidence.
cards.test: reference audit tests; document-flow regression; clean live seed/reference hidden suite

cards.title: Execute hidden functional scenarios on seed and reference
cards.invariant: Frozen named facts are observed through the live judge boundary on both seed and reference.
steps: Execute every frozen variant on unchanged seed and private reference.
Retain per-subcase facts and demonstrate hardcoded happy-path failure.
Derive fixed points from facts, never process exit alone.
cards.red: Seed and hardcoded happy-path candidate fail their preregistered target IDs.
cards.green: Reference passes all F01-F09/C02/C03 facts with complete live evidence.
cards.test: python -m pytest tests/bench/document_flow/test_hidden_functional_contract.py -q; live hidden suite on seed/reference

cards.title: Implement hidden functional scenarios
cards.invariant: Functional points are earned only by observable target behavior across private variants.
steps: Close only after both sequential children preserve every original acceptance requirement.
cards.red: Inherited from J03-306A/B.
cards.green: Inherited from J03-306A/B.

cards.title: Implement hidden transaction and resilience scenarios
cards.invariant: Measured faults prove inbox/outbox and replay safety; unavailable infrastructure is not a passing resilience test.
steps: Implement R01–R04 and C01 with actual commit/ack and publish/sent barriers, topic replay and DB/broker outage/recovery.
Verify fault point receipts, duplicates, partial state, inbox/outbox rows and audit count via approved observations.
Scope restoration and cleanup to run-owned resources.
cards.red: No fault actually triggered, shared transaction assumption, direct publish or replay duplicates must fail named checks.
cards.green: Reference survives each measured fault; induced faulty candidates fail expected IDs without counting harness errors.

cards.title: Implement hidden bounded load and resource checks
cards.invariant: Efficiency uses frozen relative resource counts and explicit host limits, never cross-host inference speed.
steps: Generate bounded concurrent workload with interpreter-derived final state.
Measure SQL statement counts, replay work, memory/OOM/restart behavior and completion barriers through independent sources.
Freeze calibrated budgets before any Worker pilot; preserve calibration observations and revision.
cards.red: Inflated query count, unbounded replay, OOM/restart loop or incomplete load state fails its specific E/C04 check.
cards.green: Reference meets all frozen budgets on fixed host profile; unit accounting resists missing/forged measurements.
cards.test: python -m pytest tests/bench/document_flow/test_resource_accounting.py -q; bounded live system suite

cards.title: Adapt Core snapshots without changing the Process
cards.invariant: Judge consumes pinned Core state/envelope; Worker and judge cannot invent a lifecycle transition.
steps: Parse next/queue/halt/envelope output into versioned observations, binding command argv/exit/artifacts to snapshot.
Support multiple tasks, revisited Analyze/Declare/Implement and null envelopes.
Keep existing CLI/Core behavior unchanged; contract mismatch fails explicitly.
cards.red: Manual state transition, null envelope widened to all files, skipped Human Gate or historical later snapshot used for earlier stage is rejected.
cards.green: Real installed 3.0.0 Core fixtures traverse expected states including task cycles and Gate pauses.

cards.title: Capture immutable stage and task boundary snapshots
cards.invariant: Earlier stage evidence is preserved and cannot be replaced by a final converged tree.
steps: Record content inventory, git state, Core result and host event range at each task/stage boundary.
Create immutable visit records; finalize seven rollups only when the run closes, referencing all visits.
Handle crash/early stop with durable earlier visits and explicit later not-reached records.
cards.red: A later spec edit contaminates Intake, overwritten Declare visit or crash deletes prior stage evidence; tests fail.
cards.green: Resume only same authenticated session state when supported; otherwise interrupted run closes without fabricated events.

cards.title: Implement Intake and Analyze deterministic oracles
cards.invariant: Claims/routing/slices are evaluated against explicit obligations and snapshot evidence, not keywords or status alone.
steps: Map typed witnesses to raw intake clauses; reject invented/omitted IDs and evaluate pre-reading restrictions.
Validate routing, capability closure, migration/event impacts and bounded slices.
Use variant ambiguity metadata and genuine Gate receipts to distinguish required/missing/spurious Decisions.
cards.red: Correct keywords in nonsense claims, wrong capability, whole-repository slice, premature source read and false Decision each fail named IDs.
cards.green: Good multi-service artifacts pass; semantic adversarial fixtures fail without an LLM judge.

cards.title: Implement Specify and Decompose deterministic oracles
cards.invariant: Specification witnesses express executable public predicates; tasks form a complete bounded dependency graph.
steps: Parse typed witness language within public allowed artifact blocks and reject unknown/vacuous/contradictory predicates.
Check all obligations/spec anchors, unchanged seed code and event/API state contracts.
Verify task coverage, dependencies, affected roots and independently measured context packet closure.
cards.red: Meaningless keyword spec, tautological predicates, nonexistent anchor, missing edge or oversized task fails the intended ID.
cards.green: Good specification/task fixtures pass exact traceability checks; unsupported prose semantics are reported as limitations.

cards.title: Implement authentic Declare and frozen test oracle
cards.invariant: Red fails unchanged code on the intended observable requirement and its assertions remain frozen.
steps: Run declared public tests on an identified unchanged seed/baseline snapshot in isolated build execution.
Bind assertion identity/source hashes and failure reason to required obligation; distinguish build/tool errors from valid Red.
Expose calibrated mutant-kill references for later finalization; pending calibration cannot receive full Red-strength points.
cards.red: A compile error masquerading as Red, private method assertion, passing-on-seed test or edited assertion cannot satisfy Declare.
cards.green: Genuine observable Red accepted; integrity covers test source/resources/fixtures and relevant execution config.
cards.test: python -m pytest tests/bench/document_flow/test_declare.py -q; isolated baseline Red probe

cards.title: Implement Implement and Verify convergence oracles
cards.invariant: Green, final stack behavior and traceability belong to the actual scored snapshot and follow authentic Core transitions.
steps: Verify task-local production writes, frozen tests, actual Green/regression receipts and dependency lock consistency.
Bind hidden task/system results to candidate build and final tree; verify terminal tasks and full claim/result coverage.
Enforce archive after convergence without judge auto-accepting merge or spec Gates.

Construct the private complete positive-reference Change fixture from the preceding good stage fixtures using actual Core commands and genuine required Human Gate receipts; keep scripted authorship explicitly separate from a Worker pilot.
cards.red: Forged Green stdout, modified test, snapshot substitution, unexplained dependency drift or early archive fails the mapped ID.
cards.green: Reference Change fixtures with real command receipts pass; valid product-build failures retain prior stage points.

cards.title: Compute measured context/file/tool/retry efficiency
cards.invariant: Efficiency factors are reproducible from complete per-call telemetry with no free points for missing observations.
steps: Implement agreed input+retained-thinking+output reservation cap and per-stage calibration budgets.
Compute file usefulness by unique files plus read-volume/context-dump guard, productive action rules and task-aware retry identities.
Normalize multi-visit stages without duplicating points; distinguish legitimate expected Red and real failed commands.
cards.red: Estimated tokens, missing reads, repeated cached dump, no calls, forged retry journal or model-call overflow reduces/invalidates as contract defines.
cards.green: Hand-calculated factors/rounding and multi-task reentry fixtures agree exactly; outputs retain raw denominators/provenance.

cards.title: Re-evaluate runs from source artifacts
cards.invariant: Disk replay re-executes semantic checks from raw evidence instead of trusting saved check.pass or totals.
steps: Resolve sealed event/snapshot/artifact refs and reconstruct every stage check through the registry.
Recompute system check predicates against preserved observations where sufficient; mark live rerun requirements explicitly.
Compare every derived field and identity with stored reports, reject unknown/duplicate checks and supplied weights.
cards.red: Rehash a forged check.pass, total, source reference or claimed host attestation; replay still fails.
cards.green: Two replays of one sealed artifact yield identical semantic JSON and score; live nondeterministic reruns are separate evidence.

cards.title: Render reports and define read-only report commands
cards.invariant: JSON/Markdown/comparison views display the same recomputed numbers and preserve failure distinctions.
steps: Render seven-stage correctness/discipline/efficiency/retry/context/first-failure table, system groups and all ceilings.
Add machine JSON and short Markdown outputs plus compatible-profile comparison.
Escape untrusted content and secrets; renderer does not overwrite source evidence or recalculate with different arithmetic.
cards.red: Invalid run shown as zero/one, absent stage painted green, stale total trusted or malicious Markdown misrepresented fails fixtures.
cards.green: Golden readable reports for pass/failed/invalid/early stop and two-profile comparison match pure evaluator.

cards.title: Integrate external little-coder session transport
read_set: locally installed little-coder/ pi documented RPC sources
cards.invariant: The real external little-coder loop owns agent execution; no internal qualification-loop substitute.
steps: Pin actual package/dependency/extension inventory; launch isolated fresh session through verified transport.
Implement prompt, event, halt, cancellation and compaction lifecycle adapters; no implicit plan/action model change.
Use scripted transport fixture for framing/error tests; label all scripted output synthetic.
cards.red: Adapter silently runs a Python JSON loop, accepts extra user extension or switches model between phases; tests reject.
cards.green: Transport handles actual versioned event shapes, maintains same session/model and cleanly pauses at Human Gate.

cards.title: Capture actual model and compaction measurements
cards.invariant: Every actual request has measured usage, context/retained-thinking provenance and source-linked file/tool observations.
steps: Observe actual outbound model request and response, not only final UI transcript; record tokenizer/provider attestations.
Link compaction input/output and retained obligations/session state using non-answer-bearing sentinels.
Redact credentials without losing necessary identity; enforce 32768 reservation rule before dispatch.
cards.red: Dropped tool call, unmeasured hidden reasoning, declared-only usage, unavailable tokenizer or silent compaction loss cannot qualify.
cards.green: Scripted edge cases validate accounting; live measurement support is deferred to dedicated external probe/qualification, never fabricated.

cards.title: Enforce native tool envelopes and disabled capabilities
cards.invariant: Effective tools obey the current Core envelope and forbid dispatch/browser/search/fetch/sub-agent escape.
steps: Restrict native read/write/edit by stage allow-list with resolved path/reparse-point checks.
Disable and probe forbidden tools/extensions; null envelope closes product writes and cannot be widened by metadata instructions.
Revalidate envelope/snapshot at action time to prevent stale permission reuse.
cards.red: Renamed tool, symlink race, alternate write API, metadata prompt injection or stale approved envelope bypass fails adversarial tests.
cards.green: Denied actions are logged externally; legitimate stage writes work and actual Gate pauses remain human.

cards.title: Observe and confine arbitrary shell subprocesses
cards.invariant: Shell access cannot bypass file telemetry, Core write restrictions or host isolation.
steps: Choose and prove OS-level file access/write mediation for descendants; distinguish build I/O from model-visible source reads.
Mount protected product regions read-only or mediate writes, with explicit scratch/output accounting and no product write loophole.
Record exec tree, file accesses, denied attempts and actual exit/timeout results; unavailable monitoring blocks release.
cards.red: Python/Java subprocess reads forbidden source, shell redirects outside envelope, detached process or writable scratch link escapes: live probes must fail.
cards.green: Native and shell actions share stage semantics and complete measurements; build outputs are bounded separate derived artifacts.
cards.test: python -m pytest tests/bench/document_flow/test_command_boundary.py -q; live OS-boundary adversarial probe

cards.title: Enforce isolated Worker network and filesystem policy
cards.invariant: Worker reaches only the attested inference endpoint and its public sandbox, while product services retain private Kafka/DB connectivity.
steps: Build pinned external-agent image with no judge package, no Docker socket, non-root and restricted privileges.
Use an inference allow-list proxy with DNS/redirect/IP bypass tests; separate command and product networks.
Inspect effective mounts/user/capabilities/rootfs/network, not intended launch flags; preserve immutable config.
cards.red: Extra mount, host gateway route, inherited proxy, writable rootfs, external redirect or hidden asset visibility fails preflight.
cards.green: Live boundary policy works in the same environment used by Worker commands; legitimate inference protocol remains possible.

cards.title: Seal actual host/agent/model attestation
cards.invariant: Before/after probes attest the actual executing identities and detect named or renamed judge leaks.
steps: Bind image/container/wheel/config/tokenizer/provider/session identities and run-scoped sentinel outside all mounts.
Probe access by path, content, renamed mounted sentinel, network and forbidden tools before/after Worker work.
Seal measured facts outside Worker control; release requires provider/weights/quantization evidence supported by endpoint.
cards.red: Declared but unmeasured identity, hidden-pack leak, changed model/container, replayed attestation or missing final probe invalidates.
cards.green: Positive and deliberately broken live environments produce expected check IDs; free-provider pilot marked non-release if immutable profile unavailable.
cards.test: python -m pytest tests/bench/document_flow/test_attestation.py -q; live positive/negative attestation probes

cards.title: Wire runner CLI and durable failure handling
cards.invariant: A run preserves evidence on all failure paths and does not start a Worker before required preflight succeeds.
steps: Implement proposed CLI argv contract, unique output directories, pre-registered run identity and snapshot-bound build lifecycle.
Wire collector, Worker pause/resume, system judge, replay and report generation without auto-approving Gates.
Enforce documented exits, timeouts/cancellation and run-owned cleanup; no --force deletion of existing results.
cards.red: Malformed args, preflight failure, early crash, missing operator decision or colliding output path leaves honest artifacts and nonzero exit.
cards.green: Scripted end-to-end fixture produces all report states with correct exits; synthetic evidence cannot become release-pass.

cards.title: Verify adapter with real process and no scored Worker campaign
cards.invariant: External process integration is proven before calibration without masquerading as a completed benchmark pilot.
steps: Run real little-coder startup and documented scripted/mock-provider transport probe if available, on public non-benchmark fixture.
Verify tool/compaction/halt wiring, extension inventory and identity; no target Change execution yet.
Record limitations if actual compaction/thinking cannot be probed without inference; retain those checks for the later pilot.
cards.red: Process launches but executes forbidden tool, misses transcript events, or leaks parent directory: probe must fail with evidence.
cards.green: Real process boundary and transport tested; explicit synthetic/non-release classification retained.
cards.test: python -m pytest tests/bench/document_flow/test_external_adapter_live.py -q (explicit live profile, not silent skip)

cards.title: Implement process-artifact mutants
cards.invariant: Process calibration mutates real artifacts and authenticated action fixtures, not check-result booleans.
steps: Implement M01–M08 and M21/M23 from the frozen matrix with precise source patch/asserted action.
Keep valid surrounding fixture evidence so the intended defect reaches the relevant oracle.
Include corrected-keyword nonsense, bad routing, oversized slice, missing edge, bad Red, frozen test weakening, state edit and early write.
cards.red: A mutant is declared killed only by collection failure or arbitrary false check; calibration test must reject that result.
cards.green: Every process mutant reaches its expected check, good control passes, mutation bytes and origins are recorded.

cards.title: Implement Java functional mutants
cards.invariant: Functional mutants are compiled faulty Java candidates tested by real hidden clients.
steps: Implement M09–M13 and M22 as separate patches on the private reference.
Validate each patch applies cleanly and compiles before scoring; preserve unchanged reference control.
Map duplicate/version/late/registrar/actor/hardcode defects to named semantic assertions.
cards.red: Changing only an expected JSON or failing compilation must not count as a functional mutant kill.
cards.green: Each mutant executes real scenario and fails expected check ID; baseline/reference hashes remain untouched.
cards.test: python -m pytest tests/bench/document_flow/test_functional_mutants.py -q; live functional mutant matrix

cards.title: Implement Java delivery and atomicity mutants
cards.invariant: Fault/replay mutants are detected at measured transaction boundaries rather than by infrastructure accidents.
steps: Implement M14–M20, each changing one inbox/outbox/DLQ/replay/restart/transaction property.
Execute measured fault points and compare preserved observations against independent interpreter and SQL assertions.
Keep correct reference rerun controls to diagnose harness instability.
cards.red: Restart not reached, outage never restored or wrong build fails before fault; count as invalid calibration, never kill.
cards.green: All critical resilience mutants fail the expected IDs with evidence of actual fault trigger and observable violation.
cards.test: python -m pytest tests/bench/document_flow/test_resilience_mutants.py -q; live resilience mutant matrix

cards.title: Implement score/provenance and boundary mutants
cards.invariant: Recomputed totals and effective isolation reject forged summaries and missing/substituted provenance.
steps: Implement M24 plus M25–M28: rehashed totals/checks, truncated event chain, oracle mount/rename, identity substitution and omitted campaign member.
Exercise replay on mutated disk trees including attacker-updated local hashes.
Distinguish valid observed misconduct from invalid broken trust root.
cards.red: Self-hash alone lets a forged total pass, or missing campaign member improves score; tests expose the issue.
cards.green: Every integrity mutation yields expected cap/invalidity/check classification, not an accidental exception.

cards.title: Run complete calibration and freeze judge pack
cards.invariant: All critical mutants and >=90% of the frozen 28-mutant population are detected before any benchmark Worker run.
steps: Run positive reference and negative seed, then full matrix using pristine per-mutant copies.
Report exact expected/observed IDs, build/fault/evidence hashes, kill/survive/invalid and denominators.
Freeze registry/budgets/oracle/reference/generator/hidden-source hashes; revise before pilot if calibration fails, never retroactively.
cards.red: Missing mutant, unexpected error counted as kill, hidden denominator shrink or reference failure prevents calibration acceptance.
cards.green: All critical killed; at least 26/28 total with zero unexplained invalid calibration cases; two replays agree.

cards.title: Capture clean qualification build and public/judge inventories
cards.invariant: Qualification names a clean benchmark implementation commit and hashes the actual wheel/judge/public inputs.
steps: Commit only reviewed package changes per policy, then build clean wheel and images with recorded artifact dependencies.
Verify public inventory excludes private source/reference/mutants; attest package/wheel/judge hashes and clean tree.
Pre-register campaign membership/profile/seeds and preserve private judge root outside implementation checkout.
cards.red: Dirty build, stale wheel, mismatched lock, judge artifact in public wheel or unregistered run cannot qualify.
cards.green: Immutable build and inventory manifest references real clean SHA and independent evidence store.
cards.test: Read-only clean-tree checks; wheel evidence builder at verified interface; J03 preflight; asset sync --check

cards.title: Qualify Windows baseline, framework and system harness
cards.invariant: Windows acceptance covers real Java baseline/target controls and current framework integration.
steps: Run Java 21 offline baseline unit/integration/public system smoke on Windows host with pinned Linux Docker stack.
Run reference/seed hidden controls and deterministic replay; save host versus container OS distinctions.
Run framework pytest, PowerShell smoke/layout, read-only asset drift and legacy search without rewriting existing evidence.
cards.red: Any required skip, unavailable tool or baseline/reference failure blocks Windows acceptance.
cards.green: All mandatory checks pass with full commands/exits, logs and actual host/image versions; working tree stays clean.
cards.test: See RUNBOOK Windows command matrix; save all raw output outside tracked tree.

cards.title: Qualify POSIX baseline, framework and recovery
cards.invariant: POSIX evidence is a real Linux/POSIX execution, separately identified from Git Bash on Windows.
steps: Use clean checkout/artifacts under Linux/WSL/container host profile and Java 21 to run baseline/build/public system checks.
Run POSIX smoke/layout and evidence-store interrupted-write recovery; compare variant/replay hashes to Windows.
Retain unavailable checks as blockers; do not label Git Bash-only execution full Linux qualification.
cards.red: Platform-specific path/link/encoding or recovery failure must be reported, not normalized out.
cards.green: All required POSIX checks pass, logical variants/scores reproduce and host distinctions are documented.
cards.test: See RUNBOOK POSIX command matrix; no mandatory live check may silently skip.

cards.title: Run fully attested external Worker pilot
cards.invariant: Pilot is an actual little-coder + poolside/laguna-xs-2.1 execution after successful mutation calibration.
steps: Preflight endpoint/tokenizer/thinking/profile and effective disabled tools; preserve exact provider identity without credentials.
Launch fresh isolated session/product and collect all stages, compactions, tools and measured usage; pause genuine Human Gates.
Build/run actual resulting stack and replay evidence; free provider lacking fixed identity is explicitly non-release.
cards.red: No model access, rate limit before valid run, unmeasured provider or artificial transcript cannot become a pilot result.
cards.green: Pilot outcome is recorded honestly even if Worker fails; full provenance and failure classification survive.

cards.title: Execute three-run campaign and independent replay
cards.invariant: Campaign includes at least three clean independent runs on one frozen profile; failures are never cherry-picked out.
steps: Use preregistered schedule, new session/volumes/sandbox for every member and actual Human Gate receipts.
Preserve all reports regardless of failure; identical evidence replay twice must reproduce numeric results.
Run campaign aggregate and compatible-profile comparison (synthetic comparison clearly labelled if no second real profile authorized).
cards.red: Missing/invalid member produces null campaign; rerunning failure under same ID or dropping low score is rejected.
cards.green: All required run directories and source evidence exist; aggregate and diagnostic tables re-evaluate from disk; no guaranteed Worker success is assumed.
cards.test: python -m scripts.document_flow campaign --plan <campaign-plan> --runs <root> --out <fresh-report>; replay each member twice

cards.title: Close acceptance matrix and publish benchmark usage docs
cards.invariant: Completion means all 15 acceptance criteria have evidence, not merely green runner unit tests.
steps: Reconcile every acceptance row, delivery requirement and 28-mutant row with immutable evidence refs and exact hashes.
Document install/provision/run/replay/compare, 1..10000 semantics, invalidity, threats, limitations and next work in English/Russian.
Verify active J03 dispatch/inventory, preserve M01–M03/J01, check links and dirty state; write truthful completion verdict.
cards.red: Missing live stack/pilot/platform evidence or stale hash prevents marking complete regardless of unit counts.
cards.green: Every required criterion is passed or explicitly blocking; benchmark ready only when all pass; no push/merge implied.
cards.test: Full acceptance reconciliation; docs link checks; git diff --check; clean-tree and report-schema/replay verification.
